entities.summary: Pietra Quintela is a Brazilian actress, model and digital influencer known mostly for starring in the film Princesa Adormecida (2024) and she has participated in other films such as Os Exterminadores do Além Contra a Loira do Banheiro (2018), Alice no Mundo da Internet (2022), As Aventuras de Poliana – O Filme (2020), Empirion: Uma Aventura com Einstein (2023), as well as the television soap operas As Aventuras de Poliana (2018–2020) an adaptation of the Eleanor H. Porter's book Pollyanna and Poliana Moça (2022–2023) the adaptation of the book sequence Pollyanna Grows Up.
